title: How the Catalogue Prices a Gallon on Each Refined Fuels and Propane Programme
content:
Every programme under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is written in the catalogue with a price basis, a margin per gallon and the specification the cooperative warrants the product to. The price basis says what the price of a gallon is arrived at from; the margin is the figure added over the day's rack to arrive at the posted price; the warranty is what the member is entitled to expect of the product delivered.

| Programme | Price basis for an uncontracted gallon | Margin over the day's rack, USD per gallon | Product warranted to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | the posted price on the day of delivery | 0.95 | the HD-5 propane specification |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | the posted price on the day of delivery | 0.85 | the HD-5 propane specification |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | the posted price on the day of delivery | 0.85 | the HD-5 propane specification |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | the contracted price until the booked gallons are exhausted, then the posted price | 0.80 | the HD-5 propane specification |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | the day's rack plus margin on the day of delivery | 0.32 | the ASTM D975 diesel specification |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | the day's rack plus margin on the day of the transaction | 0.28 | the ASTM D975 diesel specification |

## Points of judgement on the columns

**What the margin column is.** It is the figure added to the day's rack for the product to arrive at the programme's posted price, stated in USD per gallon. It runs from 0.95 on the Will-Call Propane Account down to 0.28 on the Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account, the four propane programmes standing at 0.95, 0.85, 0.85 and 0.80 and the two refined fuels programmes at 0.32 and 0.28.

**Which day the price is taken on.** The four propane programmes and the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account price on the day of delivery. The Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account has no delivery day of its own, because the member draws the fuel; it prices on the day of the transaction.

**Which programme carries a contracted price.** Of the six, only the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account is written with a basis that draws at a contracted price at all; on that programme the contracted price governs until the booked gallons are exhausted, and the posted price governs thereafter.

**What the warranty column covers.** The four propane programmes are warranted to the HD-5 propane specification; the two refined fuels programmes, which carry diesel, are warranted to the ASTM D975 diesel specification.
